name: proj-burndown-chart
description: Builds a burndown and a burnup chart from a tracker export, with the scope line shown separately, a two-sentence reading of the trend and what the chart cannot show. Use for "run proj-burndown-chart", "burndown chart", "burnup chart", "chart from my tracker export", "show scope creep on a chart", "evidence for my status colour", "leaders do not trust the dashboard", "are we going to finish", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
